description: Console pass 2: an employee's walk through the fixture console in headless Chromium at 1280 px and 390 px (python3 -m scripts.eval_console_walkthrough runs operator_ui/tests/test_console_walkthrough.py's walk and its checks), reported pass/fail per step: the session survives reload and bookmark without the token in the address; a search, a plan answer and an open record are each an address (#view=objects&q=..&family=..&root=.. / &object=..); a plan's answer renders under the record it was asked of, scrolled into view, with its status in words; the section jumps write no fragment; a reload keeps the open record; Back stays in the app (record to plan answer, case to case list); a pasted #case= link opens the case; no text outside an engineer's detail shows an internal code, a code path, a reason code, a source address outside the inspector or 'mirror generation'; times read in ET; nothing overflows at 390 px, one font; the rail is full height at 1280 px. Offline over the fixture console on 127.0.0.1 (synthetic rows, no business-system client, no credential); step names, statuses and counts only. Blocked (browser_unavailable) where Node, its Playwright package or Chromium is absent; never installed.
notes: Registered, live-unverified. Evidence label: isolated-fixture / injected-transport. A pass proves the console's routing, wording and layout over the fixture console in Chromium; it proves nothing about real sources or a signed-in employee. Module test: operator_ui/tests/test_console_walkthrough.py (also runs this spec's expectations through live_verify.check_expectations on the real walk's summary).
